items.title: Week of 2026-09-05: 8 alive / 17 fading / 12 dead — what changed
items.content_html:
• This run covers 58 strategy/asset/timeframe rows: 8 ALIVE, 17 FADING, 12 DEAD, 7 with too few trades.
  • This is the first recorded week for this edition, so there is no prior run to compare verdicts against.
  • Among rows with at least 30 out-of-sample trades, the highest was 2.15 (Buy the dip (3 down closes) (fixed) on BTCUSD 1d); the lowest was 0.56 (Volatility breakout + trend filter (k0.5-sma20) on BTCUSD 4h).

Biggest fee drag: 214.6% on Larry Williams volatility breakout (k0.7) on BTCUSD 4h.
